title: Kaleidoscope: In-language Exams for Massively Multilingual Vision Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy on multimodal multiple-choice exam questions across 18 diverse languages, specifically analyzing performance disparities between high-resource languages and low- to mid-resource languages.
Evaluating and comparing the performance gap in model accuracy between questions written in Latin scripts versus those written in non-Latin scripts.

Sourcing authentic, natively written real-world exams from 18 different countries to evaluate models on culturally specific knowledge and avoid Western-centric assumptions commonly found in translated English benchmarks.
